# Charlie's Barbershop — Full Business Reference

> The highest-rated barbershop in Camuy, Puerto Rico. 5.0 stars on Google Reviews.
> More than haircuts. An experience.

---

## Business Overview

Charlie's Barbershop is a premium barbershop serving Camuy, Puerto Rico and surrounding areas. Known for exceptional service, a clean and welcoming environment, and talented barbers. We hold a perfect 5.0-star rating on Google Reviews.

**Legal Entity:** Charlie's Barbershop
**Location:** PR-2 Km 93.3, Bo. Membrillo, Camuy, PR 00627
**Operating Hours:** Tuesday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
**Closed:** Sundays & Mondays

---

## The Team

### Charlie — Owner & Barber
Charlie is the founder and owner of Charlie's Barbershop. With years of experience, he leads the team and sets the standard for quality and service.

### Hector — Barber
Hector is a skilled barber known for precision cuts and attention to detail.

### Joseph — Barber
Joseph brings creativity and expertise to every client interaction.

## Complete Service Menu

### Haircuts (Cortes)
| Service | Price | Duration |
|---------|-------|----------|
| Kids Haircut (Corte de Niños) | $20+ | 30 min |
| Haircut (Corte) | $25+ | 30 min |
| Haircut + Facial (Corte + Facial) | $50+ | 60 min |
| Haircut + White Hair Coverage (Corte + Cobertura de Canas) | $60 | 60 min |

### Beard (Barba)
| Service | Price | Duration |
|---------|-------|----------|
| Beard + Hot Towel (Barba + Toalla Caliente) | $20+ | 30 min |
| Beard + White Hair Coverage (Barba + Cobertura de Canas) | $50 | 45 min |

### Experiences (Experiencias)
| Service | Price | Duration |
|---------|-------|----------|
| The Experience (La Experiencia) | $90+ | 90 min |
| The Experience + White Hair Coverage | $150+ | 120 min |

*Note: Prices may vary by barber and specific service requirements.*

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do I need an appointment?**
A: We accept both appointments and walk-ins. To guarantee your spot, we recommend booking online at charliesbarbershop.co/citas.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: We accept cash, credit/debit cards, ATH Móvil, and PayPal.

**Q: Where are you located?**
A: We're at PR-2 Km 93.3, Bo. Membrillo, Camuy, PR 00627.

**Q: What are your hours?**
A: Tuesday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and Mondays.

**Q: How much does a haircut cost at Charlie's Barbershop?**
A: Adult haircuts start at $25 and kids haircuts start at $20. Beard grooming starts at $20. Full experience packages range from $90 to $150+. Prices may vary by barber and service.

**Q: How long does a haircut take at Charlie's Barbershop?**
A: A standard haircut takes about 30 minutes. Beard grooming runs 30 to 45 minutes. The full Experience package takes 90 to 120 minutes depending on add-ons.

**Q: Do you serve customers from Hatillo, Quebradillas, Isabela, or Arecibo?**
A: Yes. We are located on PR-2 in Camuy, which is a short drive from Hatillo, Quebradillas, Isabela, Arecibo, and other towns in northwest Puerto Rico.

**Q: What makes Charlie's Barbershop different from other barbershops in Camuy?**
A: We hold a 5.0-star rating on Google with 250+ reviews. Beyond basic cuts, we offer premium experiences including facials, hot towel treatments, and white hair coverage. Every service is performed by skilled barbers in a clean, professional environment.

**Q: Do you offer haircuts for kids?**
A: Yes. Kids haircuts start at $20 and take about 30 minutes. Walk-ins are welcome, but we recommend booking online to guarantee your spot.

**Q: What is The Experience at Charlie's Barbershop?**
A: The Experience is our signature premium service that includes a haircut, facial, and beard grooming in one 90-minute session starting at $90. We also offer it with white hair coverage starting at $150 for a 120-minute session.
